diagnosis.summary: The readiness probe failed due to a connection refused error, indicating the dependency (service or application) on port 9090 is not available.
diagnosis.recommendation: Verify if the application is listening on port 9090 and accessible at /ready. Check container logs for startup errors or misconfigurations.
diagnosis.uncertainty: Uncertainty exists whether the application is not yet ready or if there is a network or configuration issue preventing access to the readiness endpoint.
